scope: one-shot whole font stack bank reused by shared Surface consumer before real font startup and after ACK/EXIT/cleanup/reap; library writable state remains exclusive

limits: Fonts are immutable Flash fixture inputs; no native SD/VFS font reads
Four matrix and five bounded text jobs share one live task; no service restart
Stack watermark and trap samples are observations, not arbitrary-font or IO call-chain upper bounds

device.evidence: compiled image/loader audit only; no device execution

ownership.gate: service-local serialized stack-bank safety gate, not a page allocator or PMP capability
ownership.ticket: instance-bound, nonwrapping u32 generation and scratch/font role; copied metadata, wrong role, stale and exhausted tickets refused
ownership.font_return: terminal acknowledgement AND EXIT AND task-resource cleanup AND scheduler reap required; metadata-only release in masked scheduler path
ownership.scratch: only CPU0 bootstrap/MIE may claim and paint; whole bank cleared before use; payload work and guards outside IRQ
ownership.lifetime: one font lifetime; no restart allowed, including after stack is returned
ownership.broker: review only, no source copied or allocator handoff; future single broker parent must remain pinned through all live scheduler frames
ownership.library: initialized data/BSS/HarfBuzz globals are not reset or lent; a pristine identity-bound initializer and supported restart lifecycle remain necessary

validation.host_zig: 255 tests passed; busy/stale/wrong-role/instance/copied-state/exhaustion and each missing quiescence fact refuse reuse
validation.python: 193 tests passed; stack-bank addresses, both independent pixel hashes, guard/rejection/return counters and private paint PC required
validation.static: Zig fmt, Zlint, shellcheck, 21 architecture tests and six default audited native ELF links passed
validation.native: exact-image P4 emulator: scratch -> real 64-matrix/five-text font task -> scratch at the same bank; all old outputs unchanged and all PSRAM returned

limits: Device primary heap is back at the unchanged 48 KiB floor; this adds 1152 B of controls/probes relative to the queue-only stage.
The bank remains address-reserved and available only through the explicit whole-bank adapter when inactive; it is not added to a general heap or broker free total.
A waiting font worker still owns live frames and blocks stack reuse; client close or queue-empty alone does not authorize lending.
Other 32 KiB library writable region remains exclusive; no pristine image/reinitialization or restart support.
Both native consumers run on CPU0; no physical Tab5, cache-off paint, general application allocator, cancellation/retry, native SD font source or LCD evidence.
Post-retirement scratch overwrites the former stack guard bytes only after their final active-frame/guard evidence has been collected and the worker reaped.
Host reference pixels and cross-thread transport tests are separate from native execution and physical qualification.
